questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities, exploring new cultures, exploring how my field of study is investigated in different countries.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Paperwork was hard to figure out unfortunately, my exchange university did not use Online Learning Agreements so that complicated things esponentially.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Upon arrival my exchange university provided me with everything needed.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Exchange office helped with providing documents, there were lots of advisors and even students who became my mentors.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: not needed, lots of information was given!

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Not easy at all, but got lucky and found housing from Kamernet.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Start looking early. Corona complicated things in recent years. Lots of people lived in hostels for a couple weeks/a month at the beginning of the semester so consider moving in in summer if possible.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: easy and clear thanks to the exchange office, feel free to contact them as they usually answer super quick.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Used two different websites.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: email contact, guidelines on university website

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I chose a course package (landscape architecture) and was automatically registered by the faculty.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: look at the website - it contains most information.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: a bit basic landscape architecture designs are being taught, the program caters to bachelor students who often only studied architecture and the classes you will be taking are first year master track classes.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: First year master classes catered to new students who are not necessarily familiar with the material. However there are lots of international students, so the program is rather diversified and group work can be interesting.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: more informal, very disorganized. lots of whatsapp group messages and last minute change of schedules and plans - apparently typical of the Landscape Architecture faculty at TU Delft

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
AR1LA011 Architecture and Landscape: Design Studio
AR1LA021Architecture and Landscape: Theory, Method and Critical Thinking
AR1LA051 Dutch Landscape: Design Studio
AR1LA061 Dutch Landscape: Theory, Method and Critical Thinking

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: dutch landscape was interesting!
